entry.title: Dr. Park presented his research work at the 2026 KSSC conference

link.title: Dr. Park presented his research work at the 2026 KSSC conference

entry.content:
Dr. Park shared his research progress at the 2026 Korean Society of Steel Construction (KSSC) conference.

  • Sangwook Park, “Seismic Design of Steel Moment Frames with Explicit Consideration of Gravity Frames”
  • Sangwook Park, “Structural Assessment of Steel Structures Based on Deformed Shape from a Single Point Cloud”
  • Sangwook Park, “Performance Evaluation and Design Strategies for Sustainable Steel Structural Systems”
entry.summary: Dr. Park shared his research progress at the 2026 Korean Society of Steel Construction (KSSC) conference.
